## Requirement summary
Describe the capability or requirement being proposed.

## Problem / user need
What user problem does this solve? Identify the actor:
- [ ] Administrator / Courier Clerk
- [ ] Delivery Staff
- [ ] Customer

## Proposed behaviour
Describe what the system should do from the user's perspective.

## Acceptance criteria
Write observable, testable conditions. Given / When / Then is encouraged.

- Given:
- When:
- Then:

## Requirement traceability
- Existing SRS requirement ID (if changing one):
- Related use case / business rule:
- New requirement needed? [Yes / No]

## Scope and constraints
- [ ] Within current project scope
- [ ] Requires SRS / scope approval
- Dependencies or constraints:

Do not add live GPS maps, online payments, real-time notifications, external courier APIs, or advanced route optimization without formal scope approval.

## Quality considerations
Consider validation, authorization, data integrity, usability, reliability, and performance.

## Test ideas
List positive, negative, boundary, and role-based scenarios.

## Supporting material
Add a sketch, workflow, reference, or relevant context.
